cardOverview.overviewText: The PhonePe Wish Credit Card is an FD-backed, lifetime-free RuPay card designed for beginners who want easy access to credit while earning interest on their fixed deposit. It offers simple rewards on everyday spends, including PhonePe bill payments, recharges, and UPI Scan & Pay. Overall, it’s a low-risk way to build credit with steady monthly benefits.
